THE INDUCTIVE STEP, now CONSTRUCTING the laws (not assuming): builds σ' with key Φ̂, index (e',h'), wPrev' := σ.w, w' := slot-min (valuation via TRANSi/iii), R' into LaurentPolynomial ↥σ'.K read off child slots (dig' via DIV, field F' via TRANSv), σ'.K = K⟮z̄⟩ ⊇ K, σ'.FQ = σ.FQ, reps' = reps ++ [Φ]; and RETURNS the `TransitionData σ σ'` witness (incl. child_wPrev, threshold σ'.wPrev Φ̂ = σ.w Φ̂, child_slotmin, residue growth, reps growth) AND `StageWF σ'` (wPrev' = σ.w a valuation; reps' pinned; K' generated by child digits). Non-vacuity chains from σ (StageWF σ hyp ⟵ baseStage_exists).

units.statement: theorem L5_landTransport {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (f f' : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hf' : f' ≠ 0) (B B' : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hd : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) (hd' : IsDevelopment Φhat f' B' N) (hslotR : ∀ j, j < N → σ.R (B j) = σ.R (B' j)) (hslotw : ∀ j, j < N → σ.w (B j) = σ.w (B' j)) : σ.R f = σ.R f'
units.moves_ref: D.8 (TRANSPORT): the triangular bijection is deterministic (slot residuals + slot weights determine R(f)); MOVES ~2326-2358
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: equal normalized slot residuals do NOT determine which slots minimize — slot weights missing, false when weights differ). Now `hslotw` (equal slot WEIGHTS) is added: equal slot weights ⟹ the two developments have the SAME minimizing set and SAME total weight, and equal slot residuals ⟹ R f = Σ_{min j} R(B_j)z^{js} = Σ_{min j} R(B'_j)z^{js} = R f' (K1 + strideRule + slotDecomp). DETERMINACY only (blueprint G6: not the term-by-term carry Equiv, which is false); the ledger consumes determinacy + P6ii.

units.statement: theorem L5_landTwoSided {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (hmon : ψ.Monic) (hψ : Irreducible ψ) (hψz : ψ ≠ Polynomial.X) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (zbar : Fˣ) (hzbar : Polynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype (zbar : F) ψ = 0) (μ : ℕ) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ ↔ ((∀ j, j < μ → B j ≠ 0 → σ.w f < σ.w (B j) + (j : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * σ.h * g)) ∧ B μ ≠ 0 ∧ σ.w (B μ) + (μ : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * σ.h * g) = σ.w f ∧ (∃ q : LaurentPolynomial ↥σ.K, σ.R f = (Polynomial.toLaurent ψ) ^ μ * q ∧ ¬ (Polynomial.toLaurent ψ ∣ q) ∧ σ.digPrime zbar (B μ) = ((zbar ^ ((μ : ℤ) * σ.t * (σ.h : ℤ) * (g : ℤ)) : Fˣ) : F) * LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ σ.K.subtype zbar q))
units.moves_ref: D.8 two-sided: stratum (ord_ψ = μ) ⟺ landing cylinder (BOX + VERTEX + PINNED VERTEX DIGIT + higher pattern); MOVES ~2359-2371, 2323-2338
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: pinned vertex digit + transported higher pattern absent). Now the RHS is the FULL landing cylinder: (BOX) slots j<μ non-minimizing; (VERTEX) slot μ minimizing, B μ ≠ 0; and the PINNED VERTEX DIGIT (landVertexDigit): R f = ψ^μ·q with ψ∤q and dig'(B_μ) = z̄^{−μm̂}·(q mod ψ) = z̄^{μthg}·eval(q) — the explicit normalization unit (pass-10 finding 2) MUST be present. (→) landBox+landVertex+landVertexDigit; (←) run the K1 sum forward. Higher-pattern determinacy is landTransport (G6 scope).

units.statement: theorem L5_realRecursion {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (hg : ψ.natDegree = g) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (W : ℤ) : (∃ B : Polynomial ℤ_[p], B ≠ 0 ∧ inC Φhat B ∧ σ.w B = W) ↔ (∃ (j : ℕ), j < σ.e * g ∧ (W - (j : ℤ) * σ.h) ∈ (fun ν => (σ.e : ℤ) * ν) '' σ.weightSet)
units.moves_ref: D.9(a) Lemma REAL recursion: 𝒲_Ĉ = ⋃_{0≤j<eg}(𝒲 + j·h); MOVES ~2385-2387
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: Φhat had no degree relation to eg·deg Φ, so the equivalence was unsupported). Now `hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat` (with hg) is added: Φhat is the GENUINE standard lift (monic, degree eg·deg Φ via liftMonic), so Ĉ's Φ-development has exactly < eg slots and hK1 gives w(B) = min_j(w(B_j)+jh). Achievable W ⟺ ∃ j<eg, W−jh = e·ν for ν ∈ weightSet (single-slot realizers hS6a, hWS). Parent-scale weightSet, e·(−)-image to current scale.

units.statement: theorem L5_realCofin (e h : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.gcd e h = 1) (he : 1 ≤ e) (W₀ W : ℤ) (hW : W₀ + (e : ℤ) * (h : ℤ) ≤ W) : ∃ (j : ℕ) (m : ℤ), j < e ∧ W₀ ≤ (e : ℤ) * m ∧ W = (e : ℤ) * m + (j : ℤ) * (h : ℤ)
units.moves_ref: D.9(b) cofiniteness: ⋃_{0≤j<e}(eℤ + jh) contains every value ≥ W₀ + eh (gcd(e,h)=1); MOVES ~2388-2391
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: tautologically restated its own tail assumption ν∈weightSet). Now the GENUINE covering (no weightSet hypothesis): for gcd(e,h)=1, the j∈[0,e) residues {jh mod e} are ALL residues mod e, so every W ≥ W₀+eh decomposes as e·m + jh with j<e and e·m ≥ W₀. Pure number theory (Bézout / Chicken-McNugget): pick j ≡ W·h⁻¹ mod e (h invertible mod e), then W−jh ≡ 0 mod e and ≥ W₀. This is D.9(b)'s cofiniteness, DERIVED.

units.statement: theorem L5_realDomination {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g e' h' : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (hg : 1 ≤ g) (he : 1 ≤ σ.e) (hΦne : Φhat ≠ 0) (hiaug : IAug σ Φhat e' h') (fr : ℤ) (hfr : (σ.h : ℤ) > (σ.e : ℤ) * fr) : (h' : ℤ) > (e' : ℤ) * ((σ.e : ℤ) * fr + ((σ.e : ℤ) - 1) * σ.h)
units.moves_ref: D.9(c) per-stage domination h_r > e_r·f_r, as the INDUCTIVE STEP; MOVES ~2392-2397
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: hbase/hnext did not imply h > e·fr; and fr was a global lower bound trivialised by w(1)=0). Now the genuine INDUCTION STEP D.9(c): given parent domination `hfr : h > e·fr`, the child bound f' := e·fr+(e−1)h satisfies e·fr+(e−1)h < e·h ≤ e·h·g = w(Φ̂) (liftWeight; g≥1); by (I-aug) `hiaug` every child read has slope > w(Φ̂), so h' > e'·w(Φ̂) ≥ e'·f'. Arithmetic closes (omega + the two inequalities). Domination propagates along the tower.

units.statement: theorem L5_recSpecies {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (ψ : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (g : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ ψ g Φhat) (e' h' : ℕ) (he' : 1 ≤ e') (hh' : 1 ≤ h') (hcop : Nat.gcd e' h' = 1) (hiaug : IAug σ Φhat e' h') (w' : Polynomial ℤ_[p] → ℤ) (hw' : IsSlotMinWeight w' Φhat e' h' σ.w) : (∃ tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p], inC Φhat tt ∧ tt ≠ 0 ∧ w' tt = w' Φhat) ↔ e' = 1
units.moves_ref: D.10 species lemma: recenterings exist exactly at e_read = 1 sides; MOVES ~2410-2413
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: reverse direction lacked IAug + REAL/S6b clearance). Now carries the standard lift + `hiaug` + read-index positivity. (→) w'(tt) = slot-1 value w'(Φ̂) = h' (hw'); a coefficient's w'-weight ∈ e'·(value group); so e'∣h'; gcd(e',h')=1 + he'/hh' ⟹ e'=1. (⟸) e'=1: value groups coincide and IAug clears the (S6b) threshold, so such tt exists by L5.realConclusion (any Kˣ scalar at position 0).

units.statement: theorem L5_recVV {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec : IsRecentering σ σ' cc tt) (hlift : IsStandardLift σ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C cc) 1 σ'.Φ) : (∀ f, σ'.w f = σ.w f) ∧ K1At σ.w σ'.Φ (σ.w σ'.Φ)
units.moves_ref: D.10 v = v': K1(Φ'/v) is the g=1 instance of D.5; MOVES ~2426-2431
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: circular — it extracted σ'.hK1 from an already-complete target stage). Now NON-CIRCULAR: v=v' is the IsRecentering `∀ f, σ'.w f = σ.w f` clause; and K1(Φ'/σ.w) is DERIVED from `hlift : IsStandardLift σ (X − C cc) 1 σ'.Φ` via L3.K1 at g=1 (ψ' = X − C cc monic irreducible degree 1, ≠ X since cc ≠ 0) — the conclusion is `K1At σ.w σ'.Φ …` over the PARENT valuation, not extracted from σ'.

units.statement: theorem L5_recLiftIndep {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ1 σ2 : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (t1 t2 : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec1 : IsRecenteringT σ σ1 cc t1) (hrec2 : IsRecenteringT σ σ2 cc t2) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hfc : inC σ.Φ f) (zbar : Fˣ) : σ1.digPrime zbar f = σ2.digPrime zbar f
units.moves_ref: D.10 lift independence (graded/read-height scope): two admissible lifts give the same residuals on coefficient data; MOVES ~2433-2445
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: applied a coefficient-only relation to arbitrary f — exceeded read-height scope, G7). Now `f` is SCOPED to the coefficient space (`hfc : inC σ.Φ f`) per D.10's Case-K-sharpened scope clause, and `IsRecenteringT` (with RecenterSubstLaw) fixes the coefficient-digit map: σ1.digPrime = σ.digPrime = σ2.digPrime on coefficients (same center cc). Digits STRICTLY BELOW the read line are NOT lift-independent (out of scope, honest gap G7).

units.statement: theorem L5_recSubst {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec : IsRecenteringT σ σ' cc tt) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hfc : inC σ.Φ f) (zbar zbar' : Fˣ) (hshift : (zbar : F) = (zbar' : F) + ((cc : ↥σ.K) : F)) : σ'.digPrime zbar' f = σ.digPrime zbar f
units.moves_ref: D.10 the substitution identity R'(f)(z') = R(f)(z' + c̃), evaluation level, SCOPED to coefficients; MOVES ~2447-2469
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: no cross-stage substitution law + arbitrary f). Now `IsRecenteringT` CARRIES `RecenterSubstLaw` (the DefsT common-localization identity z' = z − c̃ at the evaluation level), and `f` is SCOPED to the coefficient/read-height space (`hfc : inC σ.Φ f`) per D.10's scope clause. The theorem is a direct application of that law under `hshift`. The (z+c̃)^a anchor shadow is the polynomial-level manifestation (Case-J).

units.statement: theorem L5_recRSland {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (cc : ↥σ.K) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hrec : IsRecenteringT σ σ' cc tt) (μ : ℕ) (f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hf : f ≠ 0) (a : ℤ) (Ranch : Polynomial ↥σ.K) (hanch : HasAnchorK (σ.R f) a Ranch) (a' : ℤ) (Ranch' : Polynomial ↥σ'.K) (hanch' : HasAnchorK (σ'.R f) a' Ranch') : OrdPsiPoly (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C cc) Ranch μ ↔ (a' = (μ : ℤ))
units.moves_ref: D.10 RS-landing two-sided: ord_{z−c̃} = the primed z'-anchor exponent a' = μ; MOVES ~2471-2476
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: anchors not connected by substitution). Now `IsRecenteringT` supplies the RecenterSubstLaw (z = z'+c̃) that CONNECTS the parent anchor Ranch (order at ψ' = X − C cc) to the PRIMED z'-anchor exponent a': R'(f) = (z'+c̃)^a·z'^μ·h(z'+c̃) so ord_{z'} R'(f) = μ ⟺ a' = μ. Both directions via the substitution + D.8 at g=1 (landTwoSided). z'-order read off the anchor (HasAnchorK), never ord_X in Laurent.

units.statement: theorem L5_recTRANSRS {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (he1 : σ.e = 1) (cc : ↥σ.K) (hcc : cc ≠ 0) (tt : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (htc : inC σ.Φ tt) (httne : tt ≠ 0) (htw : σ.w tt = σ.w σ.Φ) (htdig : σ.R tt = LaurentPolynomial.C cc * LaurentPolynomial.T (0 : ℤ)) : ∃ σ' : Stage p F, IsRecenteringT σ σ' cc tt ∧ σ'.Φ = σ.Φ - tt ∧ StageWF σ'
units.moves_ref: D.10 TRANS-RS: the recentered stage is a FULL stage (S1-S6) + substitution law, CONSTRUCTED; MOVES ~2478-2487
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: did not construct the residual/localization/vector data). Now CONSTRUCTS σ' AND returns `IsRecenteringT` (the field-by-field IsRecentering PLUS the RecenterSubstLaw z' = z − c̃) AND `StageWF σ'`: key Φ' = Φ − tt, SAME K/FQ (no residue growth at a recentering), w' = w (v = v', recVV), same wPrev, reps unchanged (T coefficient-pure, e=1), R' the same map re-pinned at z' = z − c̃; hRΦ': R'(Φ') = z' = T s' (s'=1). All S1-S6 + the substitution law discharged.

units.statement: theorem L6_moveReduceCommute {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (Φhat f : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hmon : Φhat.Monic) (B : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (N M : ℕ) (hdev : IsDevelopment Φhat f B N) : IsDevelopment (Φhat.map (PadicInt.toZModPow M)) (f.map (PadicInt.toZModPow M)) (fun j => (B j).map (PadicInt.toZModPow M)) N
units.moves_ref: §0 Fact A / D.11: development commutes with reduction mod p^M; MOVES ~35-46, 2489-2493
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: reduction can LOWER deg Φhat, destroying the coefficient-space degree inequalities). Now `hmon : Φhat.Monic` is added: monic ⟹ leading coeff 1 ↦ 1 ≠ 0 under PadicInt.toZModPow M, so natDegree is PRESERVED and inC bounds survive the map. Then apply Polynomial.map to each IsDevelopment clause (map_sum/map_mul/map_pow; vanishing ↦ 0; the degree bound via natDegree_map_eq for the monic key).

units.statement: theorem L6_measureExact {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (n k : ℕ) (stratum cylinder : (N : ℕ) → (Fin (n * N) → ZMod p) → Prop) (hmove : ∀ N, {x // stratum N x} ≃ {x // cylinder N x}) (E : (N : ℕ) → DigitSystem (n * N) (ZMod p)) (hcyl : ∀ N x, cylinder N x ↔ (E N).IsSolution x) (hk : ∀ N, (E N).numPinned = k) (N M : ℕ) (hN : k ≤ n * N) (hM : k ≤ n * M) : (Nat.card {x // stratum N x} : ℚ) / (p ^ (n * N)) = (Nat.card {x // stratum M x} : ℚ) / (p ^ (n * M))
units.moves_ref: D.11 the move is MEASURE-EXACT: the stratum mass is level-independent; MOVES ~2504-2517
units.sketch: AUDIT REPAIR (round-2 FAITHLESS: assumed an arbitrary family's cardinal law, no connection to a move). Now the cardinal law is DERIVED FROM THE MOVE: `hmove` is the affine unitriangular DEVELOPMENT BIJECTION stratum ≃ cylinder at each level (L6.moveAffineBij injectivity + L0.FactA_exists surjectivity + moveReduceCommute compatibility); `hcyl` says the cylinder is a DIGIT CYLINDER cut by k unitriangular equations (L5.landTwoSided's BOX/VERTEX/pinned-digit pattern, as a DigitSystem). Then Nat.card{stratum N} = Nat.card{cylinder N} (hmove) = |ZMod p|^{nN−k} = p^{nN−k} (L6.ledgerCount + hk). Mass = p^{nN−k}/p^{nN} = p^{−k}, level-independent (pow_sub, hN/hM).
